recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見明顯變大的帶狀核中性球（下方，馬蹄形細胞核）與巨大後骨髓球（中央，U 形核），細胞體積約為正常同階段細胞的 1.5–2 倍，染色質相對細緻、核質發育不同步，旁邊前驅細胞也偏大，是巨母細胞性貧血的典型骨髓線索。
features: Giant band neutrophil with a long, horseshoe-shaped nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm (bottom center)
Giant metamyelocyte with a large U-shaped nucleus and relatively open chromatin (center)
Enlarged myeloid precursors with abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Large precursors with fine, open chromatin compared with cytoplasmic maturity
Cells are roughly 1.5-2 times the size of adjacent normal cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows enlarged granulocytic precursors, including a giant metamyelocyte with a broad U-shaped nucleus and a giant band neutrophil with an elongated horseshoe-shaped nucleus. The precursors display nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, with relatively fine, open chromatin despite mature granulated cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors are not well represented in this field for megaloblastic assessment. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine should be correlated.

ddx.vs: MDS may show megaloblastoid changes, but typically has hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, dysplastic megakaryocytes and clonal cytogenetics with normal B12/folate.
Morphology is identical; distinction requires medication history and normal vitamin levels.
Normal bands and metamyelocytes are smaller, roughly the size of adjacent segmented neutrophils, with condensed chromatin appropriate to their stage.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: AML shows increased blasts, whereas megaloblastic marrow has a full maturation spectrum with giant forms and no blast excess.
